title: Secure Cross-Platform Authentication & Onboarding
description: As a Reader, I want to sign up or log in using my Google or Apple account so that I can securely access my library from any device without remembering a new password.
business_value: Reduces friction in user acquisition, ensures secure identity management via Auth0, and enables accurate user data association across platforms.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Successful OAuth Login","given":"The user is on the login screen","when":"They select 'Sign in with Google' or 'Sign in with Apple'","then":"The system exchanges the provider token with Auth0, issues a secure JWT with the correct user role (Free/Premium), and redirects to the Dashboard."},{"scenario":"Token Storage Security","given":"The user has successfully logged in","when":"The app stores the session credentials","then":"The JWT must be stored in the device's secure storage (Keychain/Keystore) and not in SharedPreferences."},{"scenario":"Onboarding Flow","given":"A new user authenticates for the first time","when":"Login completes","then":"The user is guided through the multi-step onboarding flow (Goal setting, First book) before reaching the Dashboard."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-BE-001: Implement User Module & Auth0 Integration","WI-MOB-004: Implement Onboarding & Login Screens"]
definition_of_done: ["Auth0 tenant configured for OIDC","Unit tests > 80% coverage for auth logic","Secure storage implementation verified on iOS and Android"]

title: Offline-First Library Management
description: As a Mobile Reader, I want to view and update my reading progress even when I don't have an internet connection, so that I can track my reading anywhere without data loss.
business_value: Critical user retention feature for mobile usage patterns; prevents data loss and frustration during connectivity issues.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Offline Data Persistence","given":"The device has no internet connection","when":"The user adds a book or logs a reading session","then":"The data is persisted locally in the Isar database with a 'pending sync' flag."},{"scenario":"Automatic Background Sync","given":"The user has made changes offline","when":"The device regains internet connectivity","then":"The background sync service pushes queued changes to the backend using exponential backoff retry logic."},{"scenario":"Conflict Resolution","given":"Data for the same book was modified on two devices","when":"Synchronization occurs","then":"The system applies the 'Last Write Wins' strategy based on client-side timestamps to resolve the conflict."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-MOB-002: Implement Offline Data Layer (Isar)","WI-MOB-003: Implement Background Sync Service","WI-BE-002: Implement Library & Tracking Module"]
definition_of_done: ["Isar schema migration strategy defined","Sync integration tests passing with simulated network failure","Battery usage validation for background tasks"]
